nodes.text_en: Are you performing routine 15-day cleaning or troubleshooting poor cooling / bad odor?
nodes.text_hi: Kya aap 15-din ki routine safai kar rahe hain ya kam cooling/badboo ki vajah se saaf kar rahe hain?

nodes.text_en: Have you removed the filter using the designated tabs and washed it with normal water and a soft brush?
nodes.text_hi: Kya aapne filter ko tabs se bahar nikal kar normal paani aur soft brush se dho liya hai?

nodes.text_en: Is the air filter 100% dry in shade? (Never install a wet filter as it causes mold and short circuit risk).
nodes.text_hi: Kya filter chhaon mein poori tarah sookh chuka hai? (Geela filter kabhi na lagayein).
